output.reason: The verification gate DAG spans three distinct repair-loop layers with independently auditable contracts: operator-leaf semantic closure, connected single-layer closure, and board AXI/DDR functional closure. The third layer also requires specialized stream/liveness and memory/runtime review, while a final evidence-gate auditor must reconcile dependencies and ensure Vivado bitstream and board runtime remain downstream. These bounded specialties add value in parallel. SACG memory truth reports no active retry, backtrack, or contamination blocker, so this is refinement of the current ready artifact rather than recovery.

expected_artifacts: operator-leaf gate dependency map covering all nine leaf stages
leaf failure-to-constraint and targeted-replay routing table

handoff_rule.condition: Hand off only when every stage_00 through stage_08 leaf has an explicit real-tool path, golden/numeric policy, complete real-weight consumption proof, immutable identity evidence, and boundary-localized failure route. Any missing configured capability blocks handoff and must be declared as planned_tool.<short_name> or planned_checker.<short_name>.
handoff_rule.on_failure: Do not promote operator-leaf closure or single-layer execution. Route only the compact causal slice to bounded template, parameter, or pipeline repair as identified by failure_localization_check and targeted_replay_check.

subtasks.objective: Audit and refine the first repair-loop layer so every declared spatial operator leaf is bound to trusted generated modules, complete target checkpoint weights, target-model references, numeric tolerances, boundary contracts, functional simulation, golden comparison, and one immutable semantic promotion certificate. Define bounded failure slicing without reopening unrelated stages.

consumes: upstream template, pipeline, parameter, and generated-code artifacts
produces: operator-leaf DAG refinement and certificate contract

decision_authority: May reject incomplete or smoke-only leaf evidence.
May require targeted replay for a specific leaf or boundary.
May block single-layer promotion when any required leaf certificate is missing or invalid.
role_assignment.mission: Produce a checker-verifiable first-layer gate contract for all operator leaves without free-form RTL generation.
out_of_scope: Vivado synthesis, implementation, bitstream, or board runtime
primary_responsibilities: Reconcile nine stage agents with the DAG leaf-node count and required evidence.
Bind generated template provenance, numeric policy, checkpoint tensor identity, and DUT consumption at each leaf.
Specify functional and golden evidence paths and promotion-certificate fields.
Constrain failures to targeted replay and minimal repair context.

capabilities: map failures to violated SACG constraints

subtasks.title: Refine the operator-leaf real-tool closure subgraph

expected_artifacts: single-layer merge and simulation dependency map
single-layer golden-comparison and weight-consumption evidence contract

handoff_rule.condition: Hand off a refinable subgraph whose execution is explicitly blocked on a current-contract-valid operator-leaf certificate. Promotion requires connected-kernel functional and golden evidence plus immutable hashes and complete weight-consumption proof.
consumes: operator-leaf certificate contract as a declared prerequisite
generated single-layer kernel and testbench artifacts
handoff_rule.on_failure: Keep board-wrapper gates blocked. Reopen a passed leaf only when a current single-layer CCTG or boundary trace identifies an earlier contradictory boundary; otherwise localize repair to the merge, stream, or single-layer scaffold.

subtasks.objective: Audit the second repair-loop layer for the connected decoder-block kernel, including self-attention and MLP merge ordering, residual paths, stream identities, complete real-weight use, target-model boundary golden data, functional simulation, numeric comparison, and a current-contract-valid single-layer promotion certificate.

produces: single-layer DAG refinement and promotion contract

decision_authority: May reject a merge order or boundary contract inconsistent with the SACG pipeline.
May block board integration when the single-layer certificate is absent or stale.
May request targeted leaf replay only with a bound contradictory trace.
role_assignment.mission: Define checker-bound closure for one connected transformer layer while preserving validated leaf evidence and model semantics.
out_of_scope: Independent operator-leaf repair without trace justification
primary_responsibilities: Verify self-attention and MLP merge prerequisites and residual ordering.
Check GQA, RoPE, shape, cast, and stream contracts across connected boundaries.
Specify real functional simulation and independent golden comparison evidence.
Define the narrow conditions under which higher-layer traces may challenge leaf evidence.

capabilities: map boundary traces to model graph

subtasks.title: Refine the connected single-layer verification subgraph

artifact_focus: debug_closure boundary traces and watchdog evidence
expected_artifacts: multi-layer pipeline gate dependency and instrumentation map
deadlock watchdog and transfer-count acceptance specification
pipeline failure localization and bounded repair routes

handoff_rule.condition: Hand off only when case_multilayer_functional and case_pipeline_deadlock_check are derived from the same hash-bound functional_sim run of the real board-wrapped system, with explicit watchdog, transfer-count, and boundary trace outputs.
handoff_rule.on_failure: Block board-system semantic aggregation and all Vivado gates. Route the earliest violated stream or liveness contract to pipeline_repair; challenge lower-layer evidence only with a bound contradictory boundary trace.

subtasks.objective: Refine the third-layer multi-layer pipeline subgraph so board-wrapped functional simulation is the canonical evidence source for block ordering, transfer counts, valid/ready behavior, progress counters, and deadlock classification. Prevent local smoke or disconnected pipeline checks from satisfying board-system acceptance.
subtasks.role: Multi-layer pipeline and liveness verification architect

produces: pipeline/liveness gate refinement and repair routing

decision_authority: May reject disconnected or smoke-only pipeline evidence.
May block backend handoff on missing liveness or transfer evidence.
May classify a failure as pipeline-local or trace-supported lower-layer contradiction.
role_assignment.mission: Make multi-layer order and liveness verifiable as subviews of one real board-wrapped simulation.
out_of_scope: Changing model semantics or numeric policy
Owning AXI address-map and DDR image correctness
primary_responsibilities: Audit pipeline replication and block-order dependencies.
Specify valid/ready, transaction identity, progress, and watchdog instrumentation.
Ensure derived classifiers consume the canonical functional_sim evidence.
Define bounded pipeline repair and lower-layer backtrack conditions.

capabilities: bind simulator counters to pipeline contracts

subtasks.title: Refine third-layer multi-layer and liveness subgates

expected_artifacts: AXI/DDR wrapper and address-map verification subgraph
backend handoff boundary excluding bitstream and board runtime

handoff_rule.condition: Hand off only when discovery precedes wrapper binding, all AXI/DDR classifiers derive from the canonical board-wrapped functional_sim run, and the board semantic aggregate binds exact wrapper, address map, DDR images, real weights, target reference, and artifact hashes.
handoff_rule.on_failure: Block case_board_semantic_evidence and every Vivado/bitstream/runtime gate. Route address, protocol, packing, or runtime-layout failures to memory_runtime_repair; do not accept liveness-only evidence.

subtasks.objective: Refine board-interface discovery, AXI/DDR wrapper, address/order protocol, DDR image roundtrip, and board semantic aggregation gates. Bind the exact sample-project interface, memory layout, runtime configuration, real weights, target-model output, and canonical board-wrapped simulation identity before backend promotion.

produces: board AXI/DDR subgraph and semantic certificate contract

decision_authority: May reject wrapper assumptions unsupported by discovery evidence.
May block backend on any failed AXI/DDR or image-transfer subgate.
May route repairs to memory/runtime scope while preserving unrelated lower-layer certificates.
role_assignment.mission: Produce a checker-verifiable board AXI/DDR functional closure contract before any backend execution.
out_of_scope: Free-form replacement of the trusted wrapper templates
primary_responsibilities: Bind sample-project interface facts to the generated wrapper.
Audit AXI protocol, address map, burst/order, and transfer contracts.
Specify real input, complete weight, and output DDR image roundtrip evidence.
Define the board semantic aggregate and strict backend handoff boundary.

capabilities: check transfer counts and address behavior
reconcile board interface discovery with wrapper generation

subtasks.title: Refine third-layer AXI/DDR and DDR-image subgates

expected_artifacts: integrated three-layer verification gate DAG revision
DAG acyclicity and dependency audit report

handoff_rule.condition: Promote the refined plan to Stage7 execution only if the DAG is acyclic, every required gate has an exact registry checker/tool role, all layer promotions require current-contract-valid semantic certificates, and backend starts only after case_board_semantic_evidence passes. Handoff to backend_board is deferred until Stage7 supplies real pass evidence for all three layers.
consumes: current SACG and generated artifact references
handoff_rule.on_failure: Reject integration and return the bounded issue to the owning specialist. If an unregistered capability is genuinely required, block promotion and require planned_tool.<short_name> or planned_checker.<short_name> implementation. Never reinterpret pending Vivado, bitstream, or board runtime evidence as current verification pass evidence.

subtasks.objective: Integrate specialist refinements into one acyclic, checker-grounded verification DAG. Verify bottom-up promotion, current-contract certificate validity, canonical evidence identity, bounded repair/backtrack rules, and the backend boundary. Confirm that all third-layer subgates close before case_vivado_synthesis and that bitstream and board runtime remain downstream without being claimed by this stage.

consumes: outputs from all four parallel specialists
produces: integrated audited verification DAG and handoff manifest

decision_authority: May reject any specialist subgraph with missing dependencies or ungrounded checker claims.
May block Stage7 execution when required verification capabilities or artifacts are absent.
May authorize planning handoff but cannot claim real-tool pass without execution evidence.
May block backend until all third-layer functional subgates pass.
role_assignment.mission: Serve as the independent evidence gate that turns specialist subgraphs into one SACG-consistent, template-constrained, checker-verifiable closure plan.
out_of_scope: Executing Vivado synthesis, implementation, or bitstream generation
Making unconstrained RTL or architecture changes
primary_responsibilities: Check DAG acyclicity, completeness, and strict layer ordering.
Reconcile tool protocols, checker names, evidence paths, hashes, and certificate validity.
Audit repair routing and trace-supported backtracking rules.
Enforce the boundary between verification closure and downstream Vivado/board deployment.

capabilities: map DAG defects to violated constraints

subtasks.title: Audit and integrate the three-layer gate DAG
